Title: If your hands and feet feel like ice indoors, these 3 foods could be why

Description:
If your hands and feet are always cold even when the room isn't, it might not just be the weather - a few common foods in the typical American diet can make circulation worse.

Coffee, salt, and fried food are three things linked to weaker blood flow to your fingers and toes, and each one has a simple fix that doesn't mean cutting it out completely.

Watch to find out why they matter, and what actually helps.
